measurement_note: Size S is n, the common string length. Legal tiers 12, 24, and 48 span 4x. Every source character is a and every target character is b, so all candidate segments contain only unmatched directed pairs and the minimum answer is S replacements. The accepted center-expansion precomputation and partition DP are O(S^2). A correct calibrated alternative rebuilds mismatch counts by scanning every direct and reversed candidate segment in O(S^3), so it must pass all outputs and fail only the scaling verdict.
